Australia Drops Labuschagne from ODI Squad for African Series

Australia has announced its One Day International (ODI) squad for upcoming series in Zimbabwe and South Africa. Five players, including World Cup winner Marnus Labuschagne, have been dropped from the squad. The series are scheduled to take place later this month.
